As discussed with Brent in slack, but putting here for posterity: switching on "sovereign" cloud is a bit tenuous and there is a better option available of using the API to check for instance and disk type availability in the region. Basically we would define a priority order for instance type, get the list of available types, and go through the list until we found our preferred type. Then repeat that for the disk type based on the preference of the instance type.

But we don't want perfect be the enemy of better.
